gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-comme: Comme keeps its lowercase big and its curves smooth. Bushcraft sprawls above it, every stroke one width, capitals hardly taller than the rest, letters spaced far apart, so a long page of Comme feels like a plain sans stepping in after something wildly artistic.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-cossette-texte: Bushcraft spaces its letters far apart and draws every curve at a single stroke width, closed and expressive. Cossette Texte answers with a wide-eyed e and a prominent x-height, so shrinking the heading would lose its drama while enlarging the body would hardly improve it.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-duru-sans: Loose and artful, then suddenly tidy. Bushcraft is best when its wide-spaced, uniform strokes get room to roam, while Duru Sans does its finest work with open small letters and low ascenders that let the line stay dense and quiet.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-fresca: Expressive lettering leads, with capitals barely taller than lowercase. Fresca follows with open apertures and short ascenders above big bowls, so extended reading feels modern and clean, a gentle landing after Bushcraft's widely spaced, closed-off shapes.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-funnel-sans: Bushcraft is artistic and widely spaced, its closed letters holding a single stroke width through every curve and turn. Funnel Sans is better at the plain work: tight ascender gaps and a wide-open e.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-gafata: Gafata stacks a tall band of lowercase under short ascenders, with a wide-eyed e that looks professional and current. Bushcraft's single stroke width does the showy part.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-georama: Approachable Georama pulls its c open like a bracelet and keeps capitals low, which gives text a friendly, relaxed footing. Bushcraft, closed and widely spaced, does the expressive showing off.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-gidole: Neutral, almost neon-tube straight, Gidole holds its terminals apart like open scissor blades and sets its midline high. Bushcraft earns its keep big and brief, spacing out its artistic shapes.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-golos-text: Bold, spaced-out shapes up top, then Golos Text with an x-height that fills the line and a widely parted s. Bushcraft is happiest at a large size.
gen-dafont-bushcraft-gf-hedvig-letters-s: Approachable and contemporary, Hedvig Letters Sans leaves a clear gap where its c ends and lets small letters rise nearly to capital height. Under Bushcraft's artistic, widely spaced lettering, a long page reads like a plain sans taking a relaxed breath.
